focus: Resolve the legal-entity relationship between Ripple Prime, Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC and Bitnomial; refine the CFTC Letter 26-05 collateral pathway; update Coinbase Q3 strategy; preserve prior XRP market/ETF caveats.

findings.claim: Ripple's official FCM disclosure identifies Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC as a registered FCM and SEC/FINRA-registered broker-dealer.

Bitnomial's current clearing-member list includes the exact legal entity Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC. Bitnomial separately lists XRP accepted collateral at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit; XRP product maintenance margin is separately 17%.

Ripple announced the Hidden Road acquisition closed and Hidden Road is now Ripple Prime. Combining the Ripple FCM disclosure with Bitnomial's member list establishes a direct legal-entity/clearing-network link for Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC, rather than merely an association between two brands.

As a registered FCM and Bitnomial clearing member, Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC is structurally positioned to participate in the DCO collateral path. If it filed the required Letter 26-05 notice and satisfies the FCM conditions, it may potentially accept eligible non-security digital assets including XRP after its own initial three-month restriction, subject to DCO acceptance and haircuts. No public evidence of its notice, start date or XRP customer collateral use was found.

Reuters reports Coinbase Q3 2026 prediction-market revenue exceeded $200M annualized run rate; prediction markets plus derivatives were about 25% of transaction revenue; subscription/services were about 49% of net revenue. Transaction revenue still declined 43% year over year to $590.2M. Annualized prediction-market revenue is not the same as revenue recognized during Q3 and is not XRP-specific.

Coinbase Financial Markets requested Letter 26-05, but this does not establish Coinbase's own XRP collateral usage, a Coinbase–Bitnomial clearing-member relationship, or any relationship with Ripple Prime through this specific collateral channel.

The previous archive correction structurally read back with 1,237 unique source IDs across 27 referenced shards; exact-head Python validator CI remains unverified. This run appends two source records, one run update and two limitations; the new index pointers and exact-head validation are pending.

institutional_path.bitnomial_dco_xrp: 40% collateral haircut; $15M notional limit; XRP product maintenance margin 17% is separate
institutional_path.ripple_prime_legal_entity: Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC is a registered FCM and broker-dealer and is listed as a Bitnomial clearing member
institutional_path.actual_xrp_use: UNKNOWN; no public notice, customer balances, collateral inventory, utilization or XRP deposit volume identified
institutional_path.coinbase_role: Coinbase Financial Markets is the Letter 26-05 requestor; no Coinbase-Bitnomial clearing-member or XRP collateral use established

coinbase_q3.interpretation: Diversification into derivatives, prediction markets, stablecoin distribution and subscriptions is strategically material; crypto spot trading remains cyclical. The $200M figure is an annualized run-rate, not Q3 recognized revenue and not XRP-specific.
